title: Banned heroes
explainNoPreferred: Set preferred heroes on the Players page to also get bans that protect your picks.
partyTip: If everyone in the party votes the same #1, that hero is most likely to be banned.
markBannedHint: If it actually got banned, add it to the ban slots
roleFull: No more bans allowed for this role
moreHint: If a teammate wants to play one of these, press ‘Teammate’s pick’ to drop it. Its counters move up as ban candidates.
allyWantHint: A teammate outside the party wants this hero → drop it from bans and suggest bans against its counters instead
allyWantRemove: Make it a ban candidate again
modeSolo: Party of {{n}} → prefers heroes teammates will also vote for (high ban rate).
modeMixed: Party of {{n}} → balances ban rate and counters to your heroes.
modeFull: Full party → prefers heroes that counter your picks.
tapToPick: Click, then pick a hero below to ban
chipHint: Ban suggestion #{{n}} ({{votes}} votes). Click to ban
lobbyHint: A hero that both teams voted for, with 10 or more votes combined, becomes a 5th ban. Turn this on if this match had a lobby ban. It may exceed the per-role limit.
